name: Sift: tab finder
description: Find any tab out of hundreds as fast as out of three. Search-first command palette + a no-scroll, site-clustered side panel.

open-panel.description: Open the Sift side panel and focus its search

toggle-pip.description: Toggle Picture-in-Picture for the active tab's video

switch-previous.description: Switch to the previously active tab (toggle back and forth)

promote-peek.description: Open the current peek window as a normal tab (bind a key in chrome://extensions/shortcuts; Chrome allows only 4 preset keys)
